title: Erlang security advisory (AV26-870)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-870 Date: September 1, 2026 As of September 1, 2026, Erlang is affected by vulnerabilities in the following product: OTP - Multiple versions The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web link and apply the necessary updates.
